definition: Something on the page is still arriving from the corpus. It is shown as its word alone, with no square, because it is not a state of the house and must never be read as a verdict or as a rule that could not run.
basis: workbench/app/src/theme/tokens.css, the duty block's comment on this mark: "Loading: no square at all, only the word in this ink, and aria-busy on whatever is still arriving." and on the group it heads: "The marks that are not a verdict, and so never borrow a verdict's form". The block states the rule every mark keeps: "Each duty token below means one thing wherever it is drawn".
